# John Reale
**John Packard Reale** is a former Mattel employee who worked with Mattel from 1995 to 2006. He helped diversify and expand the Hot Wheels lineup by creating and innovating a play pattern segmentation roadmap, and is credited as being one of the brainchilds for Mattel's highly-successful Pixar _Cars_ diecast lineup.
Reale worked for competing brand Hasbro as Vice President of Design and Development from 2010 to 2020, and currently works as a Chief Product Officer at BEGiN, overseeing Little Passports.
